name: Sable Hallway & Entry
description: Hallway specialist. Mid-range shop: fair market prices. We carry stools, cabinets, mirrors, shoe racks.
skill_description: We sell stools, cabinets, mirrors, shoe racks, and nothing else. Describe the piece you need in your own words (use, size, material, capacity) and we offer a matching item from our range with a price. Then send your offer as a number; we answer with a counteroffer or close the sale with a receipt.
